name: Agent of Hydraxis
label: Quest
description: Agent of Hydraxis: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you truly wish an allegiance with us, then I invite you to wage war on our foes, the servants of air and earth and fire. Each defeat you heap upon them will weaken their foothold here, and further prove your adherence to our cause.
The campaign will be long, but if you persevere then your glory and honor will be great.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your campaign is not yet done, friend. Go out and defeat our enemies, the servants of air and earth and fire, and one day perhaps you will earn a place in the hall of the Waterlords.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your exploits against our enemies ring through the chambers of the Waterlords, friend. It was thought by some that your form is too small and fragile to fight in our war, but you have made great gains. You have earned respect among us, an unbelievable feat.
